loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's rolls against a foe it has sized up are to succeed, through its next turn, after spending its turn on an Intelligence check (when it worked; never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 3× a sure thing more often than not. Default 2.25×: it costs the whole turn, but deed dice and Luck already swing a fight hard.
